parameter_policy: Small integer amplitudes/slopes; at most one small reciprocal factor. No independently compounded fractional amplitude, fractional slope, phase and radical bounds.
answer_policy: Preserve trig arguments. Final solution exactly matches the answer fragment plus any externally displayed C. No unshown log conversion.
sampling_policy: Seeded family-first sampling; no amplitude-only padding; exclude existing/retired mathematical task fingerprints; unsupported/short requests fail explicitly.
calibration: Source-informed authored progression, not external psychometric calibration. Do not inherit difficulty from numeric magnitude or response shape alone.

band_origin.easy: Authored easy complete-calculation practice using small source-supported forms and full-answer choices. The learner must choose the substitution; no primitive or substitution is provided.
band_origin.moderate: Full calculation with source-supported families and small parameters; mastered prerequisite formulas and routine endpoint values are recalled.
band_origin.hard: Reciprocal-inner hard source q-3038 and square-root moderate source q-2377; authored band uses recognition of the less obvious inner function with small coefficients. Ordinary practice retrieves mastered prerequisites.

support: All bands assess complete calculation and recognition of the substitution. Easy uses complete-answer choices and small forms. Moderate uses exact entry where supported. No substitution, primitive or routine endpoint reminders appear before answering. Domain assumptions remain; worked solutions explain every step.
